blocks.h2: Toilet Problems We Fix in Algonquin

tiles.body: A worn or scaled flapper or fill valve lets water trickle into the bowl. You may hear it refill every few minutes.
Many toilets installed in the 1990s were early low-flow designs that don't clear the bowl well.
A failed wax ring or loose flange. Left alone, it soaks the subfloor.
A loose toilet can be reset on a new seal. A cracked bowl or tank needs replacing.

blocks.intro: Many Algonquin homes still have the toilets they were built with.

items.body: Toilets installed in the 1990s were often early low-flow designs that clog easily. Today's high-efficiency toilets flush better with less water.
Well water minerals build on fill valves and flappers until they stop sealing.
If the basement toilet drains to an [ejector pump](/algonquin/ejector-pump), only toilet paper should go down it.
Many homeowners replacing original toilets choose a taller, comfort-height model. We'll check the rough-in and the supply line height.

items.q: Why does my 1990s toilet clog so often?
items.preview: Early low-flow designs didn't flush well.
items.answer: Many toilets from the 1990s were early low-flow models with weak flushes. A modern high-efficiency toilet clears the bowl better and uses less water.

items.q: Why does my toilet run by itself?
items.preview: The flapper or fill valve isn't sealing.
items.answer: Usually a worn or scaled flapper or fill valve. Replacing them is quick and inexpensive.

items.q: Can you install a toilet I picked out?
items.preview: Yes. We'll confirm the rough-in first.
items.answer: Yes. Most Algonquin homes have a standard 12-inch rough-in, but we'll confirm before you buy.

items.q: Is a leak at the base serious?
items.preview: Yes. It can damage the subfloor.
items.answer: Yes. A failed wax ring soaks the subfloor over time and can damage the ceiling below.

items.q: What does toilet installation cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on the toilet and flange. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on the toilet, the flange and shutoff and removal of the old one. We quote a flat rate before we start.
